Incubators/Startup incubators in Visakhapatnam

Startup incubators in Visakhapatnam

17 incubators, accelerators and startup support organisations based in Visakhapatnam — Andhra Pradesh's coastal hub and the state's main incubation cluster. Filter by what each one actually offers, then apply directly.

Climate Collective

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh· 1532+ startups

Climate Collective Foundation is a climate-tech startup support organisation and accelerator body, based in Visakhapatnam.

IIMV FIELD

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh· 200+ startups

The incubation and startup hub of IIM Visakhapatnam, running women-focused, social and emerging-tech programmes from pre-incubation to acceleration.

AIC-AMTZ MediValley

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh· 14+ startups

Medtech incubator and test-lab centre on the AMTZ campus in Visakhapatnam, run as an Atal Incubation Centre.

Andhra University

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

A not-for-profit startup incubator in Visakhapatnam, run by the Andhra University Incubation Council, with a stated aim of backing students and the local community.

Vignans Institute of Engineering for Women

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

Vignans Institute of Engineering for Women is an institution in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

Vignans Institute of Information Technology

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

VIIT Visakhapatnam runs VCIS, its own innovation and start-up centre under NISP-2019 — a campus route for VIIT students, alumni, faculty and staff, not for outside founders.

Vignan Institute of Pharmaceutical Technology

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

Vignan Institute of Pharmaceutical Technology is an institution in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

Gayatri Vidya Parishad College of Engineering

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

An autonomous engineering college in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, focusing on various engineering disciplines and AI-related studies.

Dadi Institute of Engineering & Technology

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

An autonomous, NAAC accredited engineering institute in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, affiliated to JNTUK.

Visakha Institute of Engineering and Technology

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

Autonomous engineering, technology, and management institute in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, offering diploma, UG, and PG programs.

Anil Neerukonda Institute of Technology & Sciences

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

Anil Neerukonda Institute of Technology & Sciences is an institution in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

Gayatri Vidya Parishad College for Degree and PG Courses Autonomous

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

Gayatri Vidya Parishad College for Degree and PG Courses Autonomous is an institution in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

GITAM - DEEMED TO BE UNIVERSITY

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

GITAM - DEEMED TO BE UNIVERSITY is an institution in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

STPI Kalpataru Centre of Entrepreneurship (CoE) on Industry 4.0

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

An STPI Centre of Entrepreneurship on Industry 4.0 in Visakhapatnam, incubating software product startups.

Climate Tech Investment Network

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

Startup incubator firm focused on climate tech companies

TiE Vizag

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

Visakhapatnam chapter of TiE, a nonprofit entrepreneur network offering mentoring, networking and education through Associate Membership.

VCR Park

Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

Cancer-focused innovation park in Visakhapatnam that leases lab and office space and shared core instruments to oncology startups.

This page lists 17 startup support organisations in Visakhapatnam. The largest groups by type are Incubator (14), Academic (9) and Accelerator (2). 3 of them offer coworking space on site. Climate Collective reports the most startups supported of the group, at 1532+. Before applying, open the profiles of two or three that match your stage and sector, check what each one offers beyond a desk, and look at the eligibility and application window on its page.
